svg.title: Study 1 raw data: one line per participant in each of four outcomes
svg.desc: Four side-by-side slope plots, one per outcome, each with nineteen thin participant lines and a thick condition-mean line. Panel A, error rate: the great majority of lines run downward from C1 to C3 and only two are dashed, meaning higher at C3; means are .633, .550 and .404. Panel B, conditional correction rate: four cells are missing because those participants made no error in that condition, and the visible lines mostly rise; available-cell means are .279, .273 and .396. Panel C, completion time: the lines fan in both directions and several rise steeply at C3; means are 39.9, 29.6 and 49.1 seconds. Panel D, NASA-TLX: the lines are flat and clustered at the low end of the scale; means are 17.26, 16.22 and 15.85. Exact per-participant values appear in the appendix table.
svg.text: One thin line per participant (N = 19). Open circle C1, open square C2, filled circle C3; the thick line is the condition mean. Solid = C3
≤ C1, dashed = C3 > C1. Every cell is also printed in the appendix table.
